retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style musician portrait featuring a close-up subject with an instrument, characterized by warm analog film tones and a monolinear signature-style script overlay.
triggerTerms: vintage musician portrait with monoline script
analog film grain portrait with guitar
excludeWhen: modern digital clean photography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a male musician holding a guitar, wearing a vintage athletic jersey, set against a soft-focus outdoor background. The image is defined by a warm, slightly desaturated color palette and a prominent, elegant monoline script title in the upper corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed at camera creates intimacy
Diagonal line of the guitar neck balances the composition
Script typography follows the curve of the subject's head
Warm skin tones contrast with cool denim and dark jersey
coreInvariants: Monolinear script with consistent stroke weight

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame in a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the headstock of the guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, follow the guitar neck down, and sweep back up to the script title in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Soft-focus background provides breathing room around the subject's head and the guitar neck.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones (browns and tans) in the clothing and skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool blues in the denim and white accents on the jersey.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Peach or light tan for the script lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted saturation with a focus on mid-tones, typical of 1970s film stock.
paletteRestrictions: Limit pure blacks; use deep browns or charcoals instead

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, connected letterforms resembling a signature
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exaggerated initial capital letter with a wide loop
Extended horizontal strokes to fill space
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone script title without secondary text to maintain a minimalist vintage feel.
graphicDevices: Small corner logo or insignia for authenticity

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the hand-drawn, personal feel of the original.
Provides the consistent stroke width required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s-style color photograph of a male musician with longish hair and sideburns, wearing a dark vintage football jersey and jeans, holding an acoustic guitar. Use soft, natural outdoor lighting and a shallow depth of field. Apply a warm film grain filter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, elegant monolinear cursive script title in the top left corner in a light peach color. The script should look like a fluid, hand-drawn signature.

verificationChecks: Is the typography monolinear and cursive?
Does the image have a visible analog film grain?
Is the lighting warm and natural?

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the script overlay
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the jersey
Exact facial features of the original subject
Specific record label logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent monoline weight in the script
Ensure the film grain is uniform across the image
Verify the subject's pose feels natural and candid
Confirm the color palette remains in the warm earth-tone range
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Musician Portrait + Analog Film Grain + Monoline Signature Script
